// ../../../Users/booko/.t3/worktrees/carr-system/t3-290260b9/mcp-server/src/partner-authority.js
var PARTNER_AUTHORITY_AGENTS = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(["codex", "claude", "joe-local", "dell-local"]);
var PARTNER_SLUGS = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(["joe", "dell"]);
function partnerAuthoritySlugForActor(actor) {
  if (actor?.human === true && PARTNER_SLUGS.has(actor.slug)) return actor.slug;
  if (actor?.human === false && PARTNER_AUTHORITY_AGENTS.has(actor.slug) && actor.native_agent_verified === true && PARTNER_SLUGS.has(actor.sponsoring_human_slug) && authorizationClassForActor(actor) === "sponsored_agent")
    return actor.sponsoring_human_slug;
  return null;
}

// ../../../Users/booko/.t3/worktrees/carr-system/t3-290260b9/mcp-server/src/tool-error.ts
var ToolError = class extends Error {
  constructor(payload) {
    super(payload.error);
    this.payload = payload;
  }
};

// ../../../Users/booko/.t3/worktrees/carr-system/t3-290260b9/mcp-server/src/mail-needs-partner.ts
var uuid = /^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}$/i;
var date = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;
var instant = (value) => typeof value === "string" && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(value)) && new Date(value).toISOString() === value;
var invalid = () => {
  throw new ToolError({ error: "mail_needs_partner_arguments_invalid" });
};
var mailNeedsPartnerInputSchema = { type: "object", additionalProperties: false, properties: {
  limit: { type: "integer", minimum: 1, maximum: 50 },
  cursor: { type: "string", minLength: 1, maxLength: 1024 }
} };
function parseMailNeedsPartnerQuery(value) {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) return invalid();
  const keys = Object.keys(value);
  if (keys.some((key) => !["limit", "cursor"].includes(key))) return invalid();
  const limit = "limit" in value ? value.limit : 25;
  const cursor = "cursor" in value ? value.cursor : null;
  if (typeof limit !== "number" || !Number.isInteger(limit) || limit < 1 || limit > 50 || cursor !== null && (typeof cursor !== "string" || !cursor.length || cursor.length > 1024)) return invalid();
  return { limit, cursor };
}
var actions = {
  file_to_deal: "confirm-email-filing",
  possible_new_deal: "confirm-email-filing",
  next_step: "confirm-email-next-step",
  phase_move: "confirm-email-deal-progress",
  reply_draft: "submit-email-draft"
};
function mailNeedsPartnerOwner(actor) {
  const owner = partnerAuthoritySlugForActor(actor);
  if (!owner) throw new ToolError({ error: "mail_needs_partner_unauthorized" });
  return owner;
}
async function readMailNeedsPartner(c, actor, input, now = /* @__PURE__ */ new Date()) {
  const args = parseMailNeedsPartnerQuery(input);
  const owner = mailNeedsPartnerOwner(actor);
  let after = null;
  let day = now.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  if (args.cursor) {
    try {
      const saved = JSON.parse(atob(args.cursor));
      if (saved.v !== 1 || saved.owner !== owner || !uuid.test(saved.id) || !date.test(saved.day) || new Date(saved.day).toISOString().slice(0, 10) !== saved.day || saved.day > day) return invalid();
      after = saved.id;
      day = saved.day;
    } catch {
      return invalid();
    }
  }
  const coverage = {
    scope: "recorded_inbound_pending_proposals",
    mailbox: owner,
    date_basis: "recorded_next_date_utc",
    pagination: "live",
    as_of_day: day,
    source: "email-proposals.v1"
  };
  let rows;
  try {
    rows = (await c.query(`with owned as (
      select p.id,p.version,p.kind,p.activity_id,p.status,p.disposition,p.deferred_until,
        p.owner,a.kind as source_kind,case when isfinite(p.next_date) then p.next_date::text end as next_date,
        case when isfinite(a.occurred_at) then a.occurred_at end as occurred_at,a.version as source_version,
        case when isfinite(p.next_date) and p.next_date<$3::date then 0 when isfinite(p.next_date) then 1 else 2 end as priority,
        coalesce(case when isfinite(p.next_date) then p.next_date end,'infinity'::date) as sort_date,
        coalesce(case when isfinite(a.occurred_at) then a.occurred_at end,'infinity'::timestamptz) as sort_instant,
        coalesce(a.email_context#>>'{lifecycle,state}','live') as lifecycle
      from email_proposal p join activity a on a.id=p.activity_id
      where (a.email_source->>'mailbox_owner'=$1 or (a.email_source is null and a.actor_id=$2::uuid))
    ) select id,version,kind,activity_id,source_version,next_date,occurred_at,priority from owned
      where status='pending' and source_kind='email_in' and lifecycle='live'
        and coalesce(disposition,'') not in ('handled','filed')
        and (deferred_until is null or deferred_until<=now())
        and (kind<>'reply_draft' or owner=$1)
        and kind in ('file_to_deal','possible_new_deal','phase_move','next_step','reply_draft')
        and ($4::uuid is null or (priority,sort_date,sort_instant,id)>
          (select priority,sort_date,sort_instant,id from owned where id=$4::uuid))
      order by priority,sort_date,sort_instant,id limit $5`, [owner, actor.id, day, after, args.limit + 1])).rows;
  } catch {
    return parseMailNeedsPartnerResponse({
      schema_version: "mail-needs-partner.v1",
      state: "unavailable",
      coverage,
      items: [],
      more: false,
      next_cursor: null,
      send: false
    });
  }
  const more = rows.length > args.limit;
  const items = rows.slice(0, args.limit).map((row) => {
    const occurred = row.occurred_at instanceof Date ? row.occurred_at.toISOString() : row.occurred_at;
    return {
      proposal_id: row.id,
      version: row.version,
      kind: row.kind,
      status: "pending",
      decision_date: row.next_date,
      reason_codes: [row.priority === 0 ? "recorded_overdue" : row.priority === 1 ? "recorded_upcoming" : "decision_date_unknown"],
      source: {
        activity_id: row.activity_id,
        version: row.source_version,
        occurred_at: instant(occurred) ? occurred : null,
        instant_status: instant(occurred) ? "known" : "unknown"
      },
      action: { verb: actions[row.kind], args: { proposal_id: row.id, base_version: row.version }, requires_existing_review: true }
    };
  });
  return parseMailNeedsPartnerResponse({
    schema_version: "mail-needs-partner.v1",
    state: items.length ? "ready" : "empty",
    coverage,
    items,
    more,
    next_cursor: more ? btoa(JSON.stringify({ v: 1, owner, day, id: items.at(-1)?.proposal_id })) : null,
    send: false
  });
}
function parseMailNeedsPartnerResponse(value) {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || !("schema_version" in value) || value.schema_version !== "mail-needs-partner.v1" || !("state" in value) || !["ready", "empty", "unavailable"].includes(String(value.state)) || !("send" in value) || value.send !== false || !("coverage" in value) || !value.coverage || typeof value.coverage !== "object" || !("mailbox" in value.coverage) || !["joe", "dell"].includes(String(value.coverage.mailbox)) || !("items" in value) || !Array.isArray(value.items) || value.items.length > 50 || !("more" in value) || typeof value.more !== "boolean" || !("next_cursor" in value) || (value.more ? typeof value.next_cursor !== "string" : value.next_cursor !== null) || (value.state === "ready" ? value.items.length === 0 : value.items.length !== 0 || value.more)) throw Error("mail_needs_partner_response_invalid");
  for (const item of value.items) {
    if (!item || !uuid.test(item.proposal_id) || !Number.isInteger(item.version) || item.version < 1 || item.status !== "pending" || !Object.hasOwn(actions, item.kind) || !(item.decision_date === null || typeof item.decision_date === "string" && date.test(item.decision_date) && new Date(item.decision_date).toISOString().slice(0, 10) === item.decision_date) || !Array.isArray(item.reason_codes) || item.reason_codes.length !== 1 || !["recorded_overdue", "recorded_upcoming", "decision_date_unknown"].includes(item.reason_codes[0]) || !item.source || !uuid.test(item.source.activity_id) || !Number.isInteger(item.source.version) || item.source.version < 1 || (item.source.instant_status === "unknown" ? item.source.occurred_at !== null : item.source.instant_status !== "known" || !instant(item.source.occurred_at)) || item.action?.verb !== actions[item.kind] || item.action?.args?.proposal_id !== item.proposal_id || item.action?.args?.base_version !== item.version || item.action?.requires_existing_review !== true) throw Error("mail_needs_partner_response_invalid");
  }
  return value;
}

var mail_needs_partner_default = {
  source: "mcp-server/src/mail-needs-partner.ts",
  createTools: () => ({
    "read-mail-needs-partner": {
      write: false,
      description: "Rank recorded inbound pending email decisions for the verified partner mailbox. Recorded overdue dates first, upcoming dates next, unknown dates last. Returns reasons, versions and existing review command references. Perform the existing proposal review before confirming. Never sends or interprets email instructions. Unavailable differs from empty.",
      inputSchema: mailNeedsPartnerInputSchema,
      handler: readMailNeedsPartner
    }
  })
};
export {
  mail_needs_partner_default as family,
  parseMailNeedsPartnerResponse
};
